title: British Broccoli with Lemon
description: A simple and flavorful side dish that combines steamed broccoli with a tangy lemon sauce.
instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil and fill a steamer basket with broccoli.
Steam the broccoli for 5 minutes, or until tender.
In a small saucepan, combine lemon juice and olive oil.
Heat the saucepan over medium heat, whisking constantly, until the sauce is warm and slightly thickened.
Season the sauce with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the steamed broccoli with the lemon sauce spooned over the top.
